essayTitle: Sarawak Laksa: Breakfast of the Gods
source: SPM 2026 Trial · SBP · English Paper 2 · Part 3 Q5 · Review, 200–250 words
paragraphs: Are you a food lover searching for your next delicious adventure? Recently, I tried a popular dish that has won the hearts of food lovers across the country, and I simply must tell you about it.

The name of the food is Sarawak laksa. I found out about it through a viral TikTok video by a well-known food influencer. The video showed a steaming bowl of rich, orange broth, and I could not resist trying it.

What makes Sarawak laksa special is its unique broth. It is made from a sambal paste, coconut milk and fragrant spices, giving it a rich yet tangy flavour unlike any other laksa. Furthermore, it is generously topped with prawns, shredded chicken and omelette strips. Every spoonful is a burst of flavour.

I would highly recommend Sarawak laksa to others because it offers a true taste of Sarawak's heritage. The late celebrity chef Anthony Bourdain even called it the "breakfast of the gods". Moreover, it is affordable and widely available. A satisfying bowl costs less than fifteen ringgit at most coffee shops in Kuching.
In a nutshell, Sarawak laksa is a must-try dish for every food lover. Once you take your first sip, you will understand why it is so popular!
